name: Deep Learning 11 — Practice Lab (Word Vectors and Character-Level Text Generation)
description: Guided learner workspace for the eleventh lab of a Deep Learning course (2.0, run in Google Colab) on word embeddings and character-level text generation. On the Inno Agent side a tutor works: the learner runs the ready-made cells of their own two Colab notebooks (PTE_DL11_W2V_COLAB_EN.ipynb, then PTE_DL11_text_generation_COLAB_EN.ipynb) one at a time, in the order fixed by the cell map (77 points: E01 GPU gate; W01–W23 Gensim, the 100-dimensional GloVe vectors, cosine similarity, neighbours, difference vectors and the king − man + woman analogy, odd-one-out rounds over several word groups and a repeated cell; S01 switch to the second notebook in a separate runtime with a GPU and the 2026.04 runtime version; T00 TensorFlow/tf_keras/GPU check; T01–T41 the Rejtő corpus download, the character set, char2idx/idx2char, the 101-character sequences with the input–target shift, shuffling and 64-size batches, Embedding–GRU–Dense, the stateful training model and a separate batch-1 copy, cross-entropy with from_logits, the initial loss and its exponential, configuration and per-epoch checkpoints, the 30-epoch training, the latest checkpoint, weight loading, the generation function and its single sampling steps; then Z01–Z10 as a ten-question closing test). Eleven points are discussion only (S01 and Z01–Z10); the other 66 are code cells. The detailed lesson script holds the complete code and the interpretation questions, the concept guide supplies the conceptual support, the source notes record the public sources and the runtime version, and the resume notes give the recovery path after a Colab error or a lost runtime. The learner writes no code, submits no notebook and saves no artifact; no homework and no extra task.
